source.title: [re:DEFINICIJA] dr. sc. Josipa Nemet: Suvremeni spolni odgoj je ideološki preodgoj djece (ep. 7)

summary.title_hr: [re:DEFINICIJA] dr. sc. Josipa Nemet: Suvremeni spolni odgoj je ideološki preodgoj djece (ep. 7)
summary.abstract_hr: U sedmoj epizodi podcasta re:DEFINICIJA, molekularna biologinja dr. sc. Josipa Nemet analizira uvođenje zdravstvenog odgoja u škole, kritizirajući ga kao ideološki preodgoj i rano seksualiziranje djece. Iz znanstvene i neurobiološke perspektive objašnjava zašto djeca nisu razvojno spremna za autonomiju u spolnosti te upozorava na štetnost kontracepcije i marginalizaciju uloge roditelja. Predstavlja rad udruge Članak 64. koja se bori za ustavna prava roditelja na odgoj djece te nudi savjete o zdravom pristupu dječjem razvoju i razgovoru o seksualnosti.
key_points: Zdravstveni odgoj koji se uvodi u škole, poput pilot-projekta u Rijeci, sadrži elemente rodne ideologije i rane seksualizacije koji zbunjuju djecu.
Dječji mozak neurobiološki nije razvijen za donošenje zrelih odluka o spolnosti jer mu nedostaju razvijene strukture za samoregulaciju i procjenu dugoročnih posljedica.
Koncept 'pristanka' u dječjoj dobi je problematičan i povijesno ukorijenjen u pedofilskom narativu koji djetetu daje neprimjerenu autonomiju.
Moderna psihologija je degradirana jer je zanemarila biologiju i evolucijski razvoj čovjeka, fokusirajući se isključivo na trenutne osjećaje.
Udruga Članak 64. osnovana je s ciljem zaštite ustavnog prava roditelja da samostalno odlučuju o odgoju i vrijednostima svoje djece.
Zdrav odgoj zahtijeva prisutnost roditelja, postavljanje jasnih granica i dopuštanje blage frustracije poput dosade kako bi dijete razvilo samoregulaciju.
summary.title_en: [re:DEFINITION] dr. sc. Josipa Nemet: Contemporary sex education is the ideological re-education of children (ep. 7)
summary.abstract_en: In the seventh episode of the podcast re:DEFINICIJA, molecular biologist Dr. Sc. Josipa Nemet analyzes the introduction of health education into schools, criticizing it as ideological re-education and early sexualization of children. From a scientific and neurobiological perspective, she explains why children are not developmentally ready for autonomy in sexuality and warns of the harmfulness of contraception and the marginalization of the role of parents. She presents the work of the association Članak 64. which fights for the constitutional rights of parents to raise children and offers advice on a healthy approach to child development and conversation about sexuality.
key_points_en: Health education which is being introduced into schools, like the pilot project in Rijeka, contains elements of gender ideology and early sexualization which confuse children.
A child's brain is not neurobiologically developed for making mature decisions about sexuality because it lacks developed structures for self-regulation and the assessment of long-term consequences.
The concept of 'consent' in childhood is problematic and historically rooted in a pedophilic narrative which gives a child inappropriate autonomy.
Modern psychology is degraded because it has neglected biology and the evolutionary development of man, focusing exclusively on momentary feelings.
Udruga Članak 64. was founded with the goal of protecting the constitutional right of parents to independently decide on the upbringing and values of their children.
Healthy upbringing requires the presence of parents, setting clear boundaries and allowing mild frustration such as boredom so that the child would develop self-regulation.
